Effect of contact ratio on the primary stability of a cementless total hip arthroplasty

M. Reimeringer, N. Nuño Espace ÉTS (ETS) 2015-01-01 link
相关性: 该论文直接研究了无骨水泥全髋关节置换术的接触比与初始稳定性，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
边界: It may not include patient-specific geometry or detailed Gruen zone stress analysis, but it directly addresses primary stability.
动机· 探讨接触比对无骨水泥全髋假体初始稳定性的影响
方法· 通过有限元模拟分析不同接触比下的假体-骨界面微动
结果· 接触比显著影响微动分布，适当接触比可提高稳定性
验证· 基于数值模拟或机械测试验证
English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate how the contact ratio between stem and bone affects the primary stability of cementless total hip arthroplasty.
Method· Finite element simulations were performed to analyze micromotion at the bone-implant interface under varying contact ratios.
Result· The contact ratio significantly influenced micromotion patterns, with an optimal range improving initial stability.
Validation· Validation was likely conducted through numerical benchmarks or experimental mechanical tests.

Lower periprosthetic bone loss and good fixation of an ultra-short stem compared to a conventional stem in uncemented total hip arthroplasty.

Mats Salemyr, Olle Muren, Torbjörn Ahl, Henrik Bodén, Thomas Eisler et al. Acta orthopaedica 2015-01-01 10.3109/17453674.2015.1067087
单位: a Department of Orthopaedics, Danderyd Hospital and Department of Clinical Sciences at Danderyd Hospital (KIDS), Karolinska Institutet , Stockholm, Sweden.
通讯: Olof Sköldenberg @ a Department of Orthopaedics, Danderyd Hospital and Department of Clinical Sciences at Danderyd Hospital (KIDS), Karolin [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接比较了超短柄与传统柄在非骨水泥全髋置换术后股骨近端骨密度变化和微动情况，提供了关于应力遮挡和固定效果的临床证据。
边界: This paper does not include finite element modeling or contact mechanics; it is a clinical study without biomechanical simulations.
动机· 验证超短柄是否比传统柄更能减少股骨近端的应力遮挡性骨丢失。
方法· 将51名患者随机分组，采用DXA测量Gruen分区骨密度，RSA测量柄迁移。
结果· 超短柄组在Gruen 1区和7区骨密度下降更少，但早期迁移更大，后期稳定。
验证· 随机对照临床试验，以DXA和RSA作为客观测量手段。
English summary & terms
Motivation· To test whether an ultra-short uncemented stem induces less periprosthetic bone loss due to stress shielding compared to a conventional tapered stem.
Method· A randomized controlled trial with 51 patients receiving either an ultra-short or conventional stem, assessing bone mineral density via DXA in Gruen zones and stem migration via RSA.
Result· The ultra-short stem showed significantly lower bone loss in proximal Gruen zones 1 and 7 but had greater initial migration during the first 6 weeks, with no further migration thereafter.
Validation· Clinical validation using dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry and radiostereometric analysis in a patient cohort.

Manufacturing and properties of titanium-based materials produced by selective laser melting

Hooyar Attar Australasian Journal of Paramedicine 2015-01-01 link
相关性: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化制造钛基材料及其力学性能，特别是多孔结构对弹性模量的影响，但与生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、疲劳特性及表面形貌等关键因素关联不足。

方法· 优化SLM参数并添加TiB2形成Ti-TiB复合材料
结果· 获得接近全致密钛部件，强度和硬度提升，多孔样品弹性模量降低

English summary & terms
Motivation· To enhance the mechanical properties of commercially pure titanium and titanium-matrix composites produced by selective laser melting.
Method· Selective laser melting (SLM) parameters were optimized and TiB2 was added to form in-situ Ti-TiB composites with refined grain structures.
Result· Nearly fully dense CP-Ti parts with improved microhardness (261 Hv) and compressive strength (1136 MPa) were achieved; porous composites exhibited Young's moduli as low as 23 GPa.
Validation· Mechanical testing including microhardness, compression, and tensile tests, along with fractography analysis of failed specimens.

Motivation· To design an open-source piezoelectric inkjet print-head for bioprinting that is low-cost, reproducible, and versatile.
Method· Finite element modeling was used to optimize the shear rate during dispensing, and the device was fabricated using 3D printing and assembled with biocompatible materials.

Validation· The FE models were validated by printing experiments with water, gelatin, and cell culture media, and cell viability was assessed using CellTiter-Blue and LIVE/DEAD assays.

Motivation· To improve the osteoblastic commitment of human mesenchymal stem cells on Ti-6Al-4V implant surfaces via ultrafast laser surface texturing.
Method· Femtosecond laser direct writing was used to generate laser-induced periodic surface structures, nanopillars, and microcolumns on Ti-6Al-4V substrates.

Motivation· To evaluate and compare the influence of implant design on tissue response in a ligature-induced peri-implantitis canine model.
Method· Conventional threaded and tantalum-based porous implants were placed in canine extraction sockets, and peri-implantitis was induced by subgingival ligatures.
Result· Implant design did not significantly affect clinical or histomorphometric outcomes under peri-implantitis; porous implants showed more bone formation along the implant length.
Validation· Canine animal study with histologic and histomorphometric assessments after 12 and 26 weeks.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate how surface chemistry and wettability of dental implants influence early osseointegration.
Method· Two commercial implant surfaces (sandblasted/acid-etched vs. same + storage in isotonic saline) were compared in rabbit tibiae at 14 and 28 days.
Result· Implants with lower surface carbon and higher hydrophilicity showed accelerated osseointegration, with 1.5-fold higher BIC and BAFO at 28 days.
Validation· Validation via histomorphometric analysis (BIC, BAFO) and ANOVA statistical testing.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To develop a hierarchical hybrid micro/nanorough strontium-loaded titanium surface for enhanced osseointegration.
Method· The MNT-Sr surface was fabricated by hydrofluoric acid etching followed by magnetron sputtering of SrTiO3, and evaluated in vitro with osteoblasts and in vivo with rat femur implantation.

Validation· In vivo validation was performed by implanting samples into rat distal femurs for 12 weeks, measuring bone-implant contact and maximal pullout force.

动机· 评估骨膜下钛植入体周围新骨形成质量及纳米压痕法测量弹性模量的可行性。

English summary & terms
Motivation· To evaluate bone formation quality around subperiosteal titanium implants and test nanoindentation for measuring bone elastic properties.
Method· Subperiosteal plates with two fixation methods were implanted in rabbit femurs; after 3 months, histometry and nanoindentation were performed.
Result· Trough fixation improved osseointegration, but new bone had inferior hardness and modulus compared to mature cortical bone.
Validation· Animal study with histometric analysis and nanoindentation mechanical testing.

Validation· Clinical validation through a prospective cohort study with no patient dropout and 3-year follow-up.

English summary & terms
Motivation· To investigate the influence of local bone density on implant cumulative survival rates and identify prognostic factors.
Method· A retrospective analysis of 2,684 implants in 1,377 patients was conducted, grouping implants by bone density according to Lekholm and Zarb classification and assessing survival and failure reasons.
Result· Implant survival decreased with decreasing bone density, with low bone density associated with age over 50 and posterior maxilla; diabetes and nonthreaded implants were risk factors in high-density bone, while age, smoking, nonthreaded implants, and immediate loading were risks in low-density bone.
Validation· Statistical analysis and multivariate regression on clinical patient data.

Motivation· This randomized clinical trial compared short-stem versus standard-stem total hip arthroplasty to evaluate whether short-stems improve functional outcomes.
